场景概览

先读懂剧情，再逐句学英语。

时间

第 4 季第 8 集 · 季中决战（约 18 分钟完整场景）

地点

佐治亚州韦斯特监狱（West Georgia Correctional Facility）

冲突

总督（Governor）率军夺取监狱，Rick 拒绝撤离，谈判破裂、大战爆发

结局

监狱沦陷，众人失散，Beth 被掳走

“We’re not too far gone. I know we all can change.”本集最著名的台词——Rick 在屠戮前夜仍相信人性可以回头。整段场景以“谈判 → 决裂 → 战争 → 离散”为脉络，是学习威胁、说服、军事与情感表达的真实语料库。
说明本学习文件基于 AI 语音转写并人工校对，枪声与背景音下的个别对白已按剧情语境校正。说话人归属依据剧情推测，仅供理解参考。

逐句精学

点击每句下方的播放按钮听原声；黄色高亮为本课重点词与表达。

第一幕 · 监狱门口的对峙

总督率军压境，Rick 只身谈判：交出监狱，否则人质死。双方威胁与反威胁，气氛剑拔弩张。

You're making the decisions today, Rick.

你今天做决定，Rick。

02Governor 总督

Come down here.

下来。

03Governor 总督

Let's have that talk.

我们来好好谈谈。

04Rick 阵营

We can't take them all home.

我们不能把他们全带回家。

05Rick 阵营

Go to the admin building through the woods like we planned.

按计划穿过树林去行政楼。

06Rick 阵营

We ain't got the numbers no more.

我们人没以前多了。

发音ain't got = /eɪnt ɡɒt/，连读自然；no more 双重否定表“不再”

07Rick 阵营

We were running low on rations then, and we're lower now.

那时候我们的口粮就快见底了，现在更少了。

发音running low on 连读：run-nin-low-on；rations 重音在第一音节

08Rick 阵营

Things go south, everyone heads for that bus.

情况一旦恶化，大家都往那辆大巴跑。

09Rick 阵营

Let everybody know.

让所有人都知道。

10Rick

Let him go. Right now.

放了他。马上。

11Rick

I'll stay down here. Talk as long as you want. But you let him go.

我留下来。你想谈多久都行。但你得放了他。

12Rick / Governor

You got a tank. You don't need hostages. — I do.

你有坦克，你不需要人质。——我需要。

13Governor 总督

This is just to show you I'm serious.

这只是让你知道我是认真的。

14Governor 总督

You and your people, you have till sundown to get out of here. Or they die.

你和你的手下，日落之前离开这里。否则他们就得死。

发音till sundown 中 till 轻读；get out of here 三词连读 /ɡet̬aʊtəv/

15Rick

We need this prison.

我们需要这座监狱。

16Rick

It's not about the past. It's about right now. There are children here.

这跟过去无关。只关乎现在。这里还有孩子。

17Rick

Some of them are sick. They won't survive.

他们中有些人病了。他们活不下去。

18Governor 总督

I have a tank, and I'm letting you walk away from here.

我有坦克，而我正让你活着离开这里。

19Governor 总督

What else is there to talk about?

还有什么好谈的？

20Governor 总督

I can shoot you all.

我可以把你们全杀了。

21Rick

We all shoot back. I know that.

我们会全部还击。这点我知道。

22Rick

It doesn't have to be like that.

事情不必非要变成那样。

23Governor 总督

Like I said, it's your choice.

我说过了，选择权在你。

24谈判对话

Noise will only draw more of them over.

枪声只会把更多行尸引过来。

发音draw more of them over：draw 与 more 连读，of them 弱读为 /əvəm/

25Governor 总督

The longer you wait, the harder it'll be for you to get out of here.

你等得越久，就越难离开这里。

发音The longer you wait 中 the 读 /ðə/，比较级重读 longer/harder

26Carl（推测）

You gotta do something.

你得做点什么。

You gotta trust him.

你得相信他。

第二幕 · 共存提案与“Too Far Gone”演讲

Rick 提议共享监狱、放下过去，献上本集最著名的救赎演讲；总督一句“Liar”终结幻想。

28Rick

We can all live together. There's enough room for all of us. More than enough.

我们可以一起生活。这里容得下我们所有人。绰绰有余。

发音enough room 中 enough 弱读；More than enough 连读 /mɔːðənɪˈnʌf/

29Governor 总督

I don't think my family would sleep well knowing that you were under the same roof.

要是知道你和我们住在同一屋檐下，我的家人恐怕睡不安稳。

30Rick

We live in different cell blocks. We never have to see each other till we're all ready.

我们住在不同的监区。在大家都准备好之前，我们根本不用见面。

31Rick

It could work. You know it could.

这办法行得通。你知道行得通的。

32Rick

Look, I'm not saying it's gonna be easy.

听着，我没说这会很容易。

33Rick

The fact is it's gonna be a hell of a lot harder than standing here shooting at each other.

事实是，这比站在这里互相开枪要难得多。

发音hell of a 连读 /ˈheləvə/，lot 重读；gonna 为口语缩略

34Rick

We're not leaving. You try and force us, we'll fight back.

我们不会离开。你非要逼我们，我们就会反击。

35Rick

Like you said, the gunshots will just bring more of them out. They'll take down the fences. Without the fences, this place is worthless.

就像你说的，枪声只会把更多行尸引来。它们会推倒围栏。没有围栏，这里就毫无价值。

36Governor 总督

Take the damn pencil.

把这该死的铅笔拿去。

37Governor 总督

You. In the ponytail. Is this what you want? Is this what any of you want?

你，扎马尾的那个。这就是你想要的吗？这是你们任何人想要的吗？

38Michonne

What we want is what you got.

我们想要的正是你手里有的。

39Rick

Look, I fought him before. And after, we took in his old friends. They become leaders in what we have here.

听着，我以前和他交过手。之后，我们接纳了他以前的朋友。他们成了我们这里的主心骨。

40Rick

Now you put down your weapons, walk through those gates. You're one of us.

现在放下武器，走进那扇大门。你就是我们的一员了。

41Rick

We let go of all of it. And nobody dies.

我们把过去的一切都放下。没有人会死。

42Rick

Everyone is alive right now. Everyone who's made it this far.

现在每个人都是活着的。每一个走到今天这一步的人。

发音who's made it this far：made it 连读 /ˈmeɪdɪt/

43Rick

We've all done the worst kinds of things just to stay alive.

为了活下去，我们都做过最糟糕的事。

44Rick

But we can still come back. We're not too far gone.

但我们还能回头。我们还没有无可救药。

发音too far gone：far 与 gone 清晰重读，是本集金句

45Rick

We get to come back. I know we all can change.

我们可以回头。我知道我们都能改变。

46Governor 总督

Liar.

骗子。

第三幕 · 大战爆发

总督下令总攻，坦克撞破围墙，枪声与行尸一起涌入，监狱防线崩溃。

硝烟散去，众人边战边撤，寻找 Carl、Beth、Judith，却迎来更令人心碎的离别。

I'm just trying to find the kids to get them on the bus.

核心词汇

音标 + 英文释义 + 中文释义，均附剧中原声片段。

sundown /ˈsʌndaʊn/ n.

the time when the sun goes down; sunset

日落，黄昏

“You have till sundown to get out of here.”
你必须在日落前离开这里。

hostage /ˈhɒstɪdʒ/ n.

a person kept prisoner to force others to do what one demands

人质

“You don't need hostages.”
你不需要人质。

ration /ˈræʃn/ n.

a fixed amount of food given to a person in a time of shortage

配给量，口粮

“We were running low on rations.”
我们的口粮快见底了。

stash /stæʃ/ n.

a secret store of something valuable

（秘密）储备物

“Someone checked the stash on the bus.”
有人检查过大巴上的储备。

prison /ˈprɪzn/ n.

a building where people are kept as punishment or for safety

监狱

“We need this prison.”
我们需要这座监狱。

survive /səˈvaɪv/ v.

to continue to live or exist, especially after a dangerous event

幸存，活下来

“They won't survive.”
他们活不下去。

tank /tæŋk/ n.

a heavy military vehicle with guns and armor

坦克

“I have a tank.”
我有一辆坦克。

choice /tʃɔɪs/ n.

an act of choosing between two or more possibilities

选择

“It's your choice.”
选择权在你。

draw /drɔː/ v.

to attract or pull something toward you

吸引，引来

“Noise will only draw more of them over.”
枪声只会把更多行尸引过来。

cell block /ˈsel blɒk/ n.

a section of a prison containing cells

监区

“We live in different cell blocks.”
我们住在不同的监区。

roof /ruːf/ n.

the top covering of a building; a home or shared dwelling

屋顶；（喻）同一屋檐下

“You were under the same roof.”
你与我们住在同一屋檐下。

fence /fens/ n.

a barrier made of wood or wire around an area

围栏，栅栏

“They'll take down the fences.”
它们会推倒围栏。

worthless /ˈwɜːθləs/ adj.

having no value or use

毫无价值的

“This place is worthless.”
这里就毫无价值了。

ponytail /ˈpəʊniteɪl/ n.

a hairstyle in which hair is tied back and hangs like a horse's tail

马尾辫

“You, in the ponytail.”
你，扎马尾的那个。

weapon /ˈwepən/ n.

an object used for fighting or killing

武器

“Put down your weapons.”
放下你们的武器。

alive /əˈlaɪv/ adj.

living; not dead

活着的

“Everyone is alive right now.”
现在每个人都是活着的。

change /tʃeɪndʒ/ v.

to become different; to make someone or something different

改变

“We all can change.”
我们都能改变。

liar /ˈlaɪə(r)/ n.

a person who tells lies

骗子，说谎的人

“Liar.”
骗子。

ammo /ˈæməʊ/ n.

(informal) ammunition; bullets and shells for guns

弹药（口语）

“I'm out of ammo!”
我没弹药了！

cover /ˈkʌvə(r)/ v.

to protect someone from attack, especially by shooting at the enemy

掩护

“I'll cover you!”
我掩护你！

地道表达 · 举一反三

每一条表达都给出同义替换与相似场景用法，配剧中原声，学一句顶十句。

have till sundown to do sth

剧中“You and your people, you have till sundown to get out of here.”

有……的最后期限；到……之前必须做完

同义替换have until + 时间 + to dobe given until… to…the deadline is…
  • “You have until Friday to finish the report.”你必须在周五之前完成报告。
  • “We've got till midnight to decide.”我们到午夜前必须做决定。
  • “The deadline for the bid is next Monday.”投标截止日期是下周一。

run low on sth

剧中“We were running low on rations then.”

某物快用完了、快见底了

同义替换run out of sthbe short of sthbe running on empty
  • “We're running low on coffee, grab some more.”咖啡快没了，再买点吧。
  • “My phone is running low on battery.”我手机快没电了。
  • “The team is running out of patience.”团队已经快没有耐心了。

things go south

剧中“Things go south, everyone heads for that bus.”

情况恶化、急转直下

同义替换go downhilltake a turn for the worsefall apart
  • “If things go south, we have a backup plan.”万一情况变糟，我们还有备用方案。
  • “The deal went south at the last minute.”这笔交易在最后一刻泡汤了。
  • “The weather took a turn for the worse.”天气急转直下。

head for sth

剧中“Everyone heads for that bus.”

前往、奔向某处

同义替换make forset off forbe headed to
  • “Let's head for the exit before the crowd grows.”趁人还不多，咱们往出口走吧。
  • “They set off for the mountains at dawn.”他们黎明时分出发去了山里。
  • “The ship is headed for New York.”这艘船正驶往纽约。

make the decisions / call the shots

剧中“You're making the decisions today, Rick.”

做决定、拍板

同义替换call the shotsbe in chargehave the final say
  • “Who's calling the shots here?”这里谁说了算？
  • “As the manager, she has the final say.”作为经理，她有一锤定音的发言权。
  • “It's your call.”由你决定。

under the same roof

剧中“You were under the same roof.”

在同一屋檐下（同住）

同义替换live togethershare a houseunder one roof
  • “Three generations live under the same roof.”三代人住在同一屋檐下。
  • “We put the office and warehouse under one roof.”我们把办公室和仓库放在同一栋楼里。
  • “It's hard to hide secrets under the same roof.”住在同一屋檐下很难藏住秘密。

a hell of a lot + 比较级

剧中“It's gonna be a hell of a lot harder than…”

……得多（强调程度）

同义替换a heck of a lotfar / way + 比较级a great deal
  • “It's a hell of a lot easier with your help.”有你帮忙可就容易太多了。
  • “This is way harder than I expected.”这比我预想的难多了。
  • “The new model is far more efficient.”新机型效率高得多。

too far gone

剧中“We're not too far gone.”

已无可救药、陷得太深（无法挽回）

同义替换beyond redemptiona lost causepast the point of no return
  • “The engine is too far gone to repair.”这台发动机坏得太厉害，修不了了。
  • “Is the relationship too far gone to save?”这段感情是否已无法挽回？
  • “Some say the project is a lost cause.”有人说这项目已经没救了。

let go of sth

剧中“We let go of all of it.”

放下、松开（执念/过去）

同义替换move on fromreleasedrop the grudge
  • “You need to let go of the past.”你需要放下过去。
  • “Let go of the rope, I've got you.”松开绳子，我接住你了。
  • “He finally moved on from the breakup.”他终于走出了分手阴影。

I'll cover you

剧中“Run for the bus, I'll cover you!”

我来掩护你

同义替换I've got your backwatch my sixprovide cover
  • “Go now, I'll cover you from the window.”快走，我在窗户那边掩护你。
  • “Don't worry, I've got your back.”别担心，我挺你。
  • “Cover me while I reload.”我换弹的时候掩护我。

out of sth

剧中“I'm out of ammo!”

某物用完了

同义替换run out ofbe short ofhave none left
  • “We're out of milk, I'll grab some.”牛奶喝完了，我去买点。
  • “Sorry, I'm out of cash.”抱歉，我没现金了。
  • “The printer is out of paper.”打印机没纸了。

I'll be right back

剧中“I'll be right back.”

我马上回来

同义替换be back in a secBRB (texting)won't be long
  • “Stay here, I'll be right back.”待在这儿，我马上回来。
  • “She's gone to get coffee; she'll be back in a sec.”她去拿咖啡了，马上就回来。
  • “I won't be long, wait for me.”我不会去太久，等我一下。

We gotta go

剧中“We gotta go, Beth.”

我们得走了（gotta = have got to）

同义替换have to gomust get goingneed to take off
  • “We gotta go or we'll miss the train.”我们得走了，不然赶不上火车。
  • “I gotta run, talk later.”我得撤了，回头聊。
  • “It's late, we must get going.”不早了，我们得动身了。

get out of here

剧中“You have till sundown to get out of here.”

离开这里

同义替换leavebailclear out
  • “Get out of my office now.”马上滚出我的办公室。
  • “We need to get out of this city.”我们得离开这座城市。
  • “He bailed before the meeting ended.”会议没结束他就溜了。

fight back

剧中“You try and force us, we'll fight back.”

反击、抵抗

同义替换strike backpush backresist
  • “If they attack, we fight back.”他们要是进攻，我们就反击。
  • “She fought back against the unfair decision.”她对不公的决定进行了反抗。
  • “The team pushed back in the second half.”球队在下半场发起了反击。

make it this far

剧中“Everyone who's made it this far.”

走到这一步、撑到现在

同义替换get this farcome this farsurvive this long
  • “I can't believe we made it this far.”真不敢相信我们撑到了现在。
  • “Few teams get this far in the tournament.”很少有队伍能打进这么深。
  • “We've come this far; don't give up now.”我们都走到这一步了，别现在放弃。

It doesn't have to be like that

剧中“It doesn't have to be like that.”

事情不必非得这样（还有别的选择）

同义替换there's another wayit could be differentwe have options
  • “It doesn't have to end this way.”结局不必如此。
  • “There's another way to solve this.”这件事还有别的解决办法。
  • “We don't have to fight; we have options.”我们不必开战，我们还有选择。

the + 比较级, the + 比较级

剧中“The longer you wait, the harder it'll be.”

越……，就越……

同义替换as…, so…the more… the more…
  • “The sooner you start, the sooner you finish.”你越早开始，就越早完成。
  • “The more you practice, the better you get.”你练得越多，就越好。
  • “The faster we move, the safer we'll be.”我们动作越快就越安全。

You're one of us

剧中“You're one of us.”

你是我们中的一员（接纳）

同义替换part of the teamone of the familyon our side
  • “Once you join, you're one of us.”一旦加入，你就是我们的一员。
  • “She treats me like one of the family.”她把我当自家人。
  • “Welcome aboard, you're part of the team now.”欢迎加入，你现在是团队一员了。

What the hell…

剧中“What the hell's going on?”

到底怎么回事（表强烈情绪）

同义替换what on earthwhat in the worldwhat the heck
  • “What the hell are you doing?”你到底在干什么？
  • “What on earth happened here?”这里到底发生了什么？
  • “What in the world is that noise?”那到底是什么声音？

语法充电

从本场景提炼的高频语法点，附原声例句。

祈使句 + or：命令与后果

用“祈使句 / 命令，or + 后果”表示“照做，否则……”。这是谈判与威胁场景的高频句型。

例句（原声）译文点拨
“You have till sundown to get out of here, or they die.”日落前离开这里，否则他们死。or 后面接后果句，可视为省略了 if you don't…
“Hurry up, or we'll miss the bus.”快点，不然我们赶不上车了。日常劝告中的 or 句型
“Give me the keys, or I'll call the police.”把钥匙给我，否则我报警。or else 更强调威胁语气

the + 比较级, the + 比较级：越…越…

“The + 比较级 + 从句, the + 比较级 + 主句”表示两个事物同向变化。注意口语中常省略 the。

例句（原声）译文点拨
“The longer you wait, the harder it'll be for you to get out of here.”你等得越久，就越难离开。剧中省略了前一个 the 的从句引导词
“The more you practice, the better you speak.”你练得越多，口语越好。标准完整形式
“The sooner, the better.”越快越好。省略句，常见口语

口语缩略：gonna / gotta / ain't / 'll

gonna = going to；gotta = have got to；ain't = am/is/are/has/have not（非标准，美国南方口语常见）；'ll = will。都是口语高频。

例句（原声）译文点拨
“I'm not saying it's gonna be easy.”我没说这会很容易。gonna 表示将来打算
“You gotta trust him.”你得相信他。gotta 表示必须
“We ain't got the numbers no more.”我们人没以前多了。ain't got = haven't got；双重否定 no more 表“不再”

情态动词：威胁、让步与假设

can 表能力/许可（I can shoot you all）；would 表委婉判断（my family would sleep well）；could 表可能性/建议（It could work）；will 表将来（we'll fight back）。

例句（原声）译文点拨
“I can shoot you all.”我可以把你们全杀了。can 表能力，带威胁意味
“I don't think my family would sleep well…”我的家人恐怕睡不安稳……would 使语气委婉
“It could work. You know it could.”这行得通。你知道行得通的。could 表可能，比 can 更不确定

定语从句：who 引导修饰人

who 引导的定语从句修饰人。Everyone who's made it this far = 每一个走到这一步的人（who's = who has）。

例句（原声）译文点拨
“Everyone who's made it this far.”每一个走到这一步的人。who's = who has，完成时
“People who never give up often succeed.”从不放弃的人往往能成功。who 作主语
“The man who shot first was the Governor.”先开枪的那个人是总督。限定性定语从句

祈使句表条件：and / or 结构

“祈使句, and + 结果”= 如果做……就会……；“祈使句, or + 结果”= 如果不做……就会……。剧中 Rick 用 You try and force us 表示假设。

例句（原声）译文点拨
“You try and force us, we'll fight back.”你们要是硬逼我们，我们就会反击。祈使句表假设条件，后接将来结果
“Work hard, and you'll succeed.”努力，你就会成功。and 连接条件与结果
“Drop the gun, or you'll regret it.”放下枪，否则你会后悔。or 连接反面后果

It doesn't have to be…：不必非得…

have to 表“必须”，否定式 doesn't have to 表“不必”。用于劝说：事情还有转圜余地。

例句（原声）译文点拨
“It doesn't have to be like that.”事情不必非得变成那样。劝说对方别走极端
“You don't have to come if you're tired.”你要是累了就不必来。don't have to = needn't
“It doesn't have to cost a fortune.”这件事未必花很多钱。表可能性留白

表语形容词与“not too…gone”

too far gone 中 gone 是形容词化过去分词，表“已无可救药”。We're not too far gone 结构为“主语 + be + not too + adj”，是 Rick 演讲的核心句。

例句（原声）译文点拨
“We're not too far gone.”我们还没有无可救药。too + 形容词表“过度”
“The battery is too far gone to save.”这电池彻底没救了。too…to… 表“太……以至于不能”
“Are we too far gone to change?”我们是否已无法改变？疑问句套用

文化背景与学习拓展

看懂剧情之外的世界。

剧集背景

《行尸走肉》(The Walking Dead) 第 4 季第 8 集《Too Far Gone》：总督 (Governor) 率领武装力量进攻 Rick 一行人栖身的监狱，试图夺取这座避难所。本集是季中决战，也是监狱社区覆灭的转折点。本音频即“监狱大战”完整场景。

经典主题：Too Far Gone

集名“Too Far Gone”（已无可救药）对应 Rick 的著名演讲——在屠杀即将发生时，他仍试图劝降总督手下：“We're not too far gone. I know we all can change.” 这一台词探讨末世中的人性底线：人经历了最黑暗的事之后，是否还能回归？

角色关系速览

Rick：监狱社区领袖，主张共存与救赎；Governor：前伍德伯里镇长，残暴多疑，因失去女儿而扭曲；Michonne：刀客，曾遭总督虐待，对其恨之入骨；Carl：Rick 的儿子，在瞭望塔用对讲机参与谈判；Beth、Judith：监狱中的孩子与婴儿，是疏散的核心对象。

美国南方口语

本剧设定在美国南方，台词常出现非标准口语：ain't（= isn't/aren't/haven't）、gotta（= have got to）、till（= until）、y'all（= you all）。听懂这些是理解地道美剧对话的关键。

末世生存词汇

prison 监狱、fences 围栏、rations 口粮、stash 储备、bus 逃生大巴——监狱社区依靠“围墙+物资+人力”生存。本场景中“Things go south, everyone heads for that bus”体现了末世的逃生预案文化。

军事口语

Roger that（收到）、Move in（行动/推进）、Cover（掩护）、Ammo（弹药）、Hostages（人质）——战斗场景中的军事用语简洁有力，常用于影视与游戏，也是英语学习者熟悉命令式表达的好素材。
